trap.label: said to
trap.wrong: It is said the firm to be rich.
trap.right: The firm is said to be rich.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura as duas estruturas. It is said that + oração; ou sujeito + is said to + base.

mcq.q: It is said ___ the firm is rich.
O uso correto da passiva de relato é…

fix.wrong: It is said the firm to be rich.
fix.right: It is said that the firm is rich.

fix.wrong: The firm is said that be rich.
fix.right: The firm is said to be rich.

rewrite.prompt: Relato com it: “People say the firm is rich.”
rewrite.answer: It is said that the firm is rich.

rewrite.prompt: Relato com to: “People believe the firm is rich.”
rewrite.answer: The firm is believed to be rich.
